title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
tagline: Five golden tickets. One very sweet tour.
about: A poor boy wins a tour of a reclusive chocolatier's factory along with four very badly behaved children.
cue: Serve the three-course dinner when Violet grabs the experimental gum.
faces: Welcome. Keep out of the river, my chocolate must be untouched by human hands.

Wonka's Chocolate FactoryCharlie and the Chocolate FactoryFive golden tickets. One very sweet tour.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersGolden ticket chocolate barsDark and milk chocolate bars with flaky salt, wrapped with a gold ticketHow to make it200g dark chocolate100g milk chocolate1 box sea salt flakes1 roll gold foilMelt both chocolates gently and pour into bar moulds.Sprinkle with a little flaky salt and set in the fridge.Wrap each in paper, slipping a gold foil ticket under one wrapper.Veruca's nut room cinnamon nutsWalnuts, pecans and almonds coated in cinnamon sugar and roastedHow to make it1 egg white100g walnuts100g pecans100g almonds80g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamonWhisk the egg white until frothy and toss with the walnuts, pecans and almonds.Coat in the sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.Roast at 160°C for 20 minutes, stirring twice.Cool and break apart.Bucket family cabbage and bacon soupThe thin soup the Buckets eat every nightHow to make itAs written, serves 4A proper version: savoy cabbage, onion, carrot and potato simmered in chicken stock with smoky bacon and thyme, finished with butter, pepper and crusty bread.Fry 150g diced bacon in a large pot until golden.Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots and soften 5 minutes.Add 2 diced potatoes, 1.5L chicken stock and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.Add half a savoy cabbage, shredded, and simmer 10 minutes more.Stir in 30g butter, season with plenty of pepper and serve with crusty bread.MainsAugustus Gloop's bratwurst and pretzelsGrilled bratwurst with apple caraway sauerkraut and warm pretzelsHow to make it1 jar sauerkraut, 500g1 green apple125ml apple juice1 tsp caraway seeds8 bratwursts4 soft pretzels1 jar wholegrain mustardSimmer the sauerkraut with the grated apple, apple juice and caraway.Grill the bratwurst over medium heat, turning, until browned all over.Warm the pretzels at 180°C.Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.Three-course gum roast beef dinnerThe gum that tastes of tomato soup and roast beefHow to make itAs written, serves 4Little cups of roast tomato and basil soup to start, then sirloin roasted pink and sliced, with baked potatoes loaded with butter and sour cream.Roast 1kg halved tomatoes, an onion and 3 garlic cloves at 200°C for 35 minutes, then blitz with 300ml stock and basil for soup.Bake 4 potatoes at 200°C for 1 hour.Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear all over and roast at 200°C to 52°C inside, about 30 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice.Split the potatoes and load with butter, sour cream and chives.SweetsBlueberry pie and ice creamLattice topped blueberry pie served with ice creamHow to make it750g frozen blueberries150g caster sugar1 lemon3 tbsp cornflour4 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry1 L vanilla ice creamToss the blueberries with the sugar, lemon juice and cornflour.Line a pie dish with two sheets of pastry and fill.Weave a lattice from the other two sheets.Bake at 190°C.Cool before slicing, then serve with ice cream.DrinksChocolate river hot chocolateThick frothy hot chocolate made with milk, cream and two chocolatesHow to make it800ml full cream milk200ml thickened cream100g dark chocolate50g milk chocolateHeat the milk and cream until steaming.Whisk in the chopped chocolate and keep whisking hard until thick and frothy like the waterfall.Pour into four mugs.
